author: Inside Edition
description: O.J. Simpson's double-murder trial in 1995 is one of the most famous in American history. Simpson was found not guilty. More than 30 years later, The New York Times has reported an unsealed court document showed a government informant told federal law enforcement about the alleged location of the murder weapon and the efforts to dispose of it. Simpson was later found responsible for the killings in a civil trial but the knife used to stab to death his ex-wife Nicole Simpson and her friend, Ronald Goldman, has never been found.
title: Was There An Accomplice In The Murders of Nicole Simpson and Ronald Goldman?

author: Inside Edition
description: A mom is seen fighting a stranger who walked into her house through an unlocked front door. Bella Torres says the intruder demanded that she take off her clothes and kicked her 1-year-old daughter. The incident was captured on video by a home surveillance camera. While Torres was fighting the man, her husband arrived home. The attacker ran. Police arrested a suspect the next day.  The still-shaken mother spoke with Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano.
title: Surveillance Video Shows Mom Fighting Home Intruder

author: Inside Edition
description: There's drama in the ballroom, as "Dancing With the Stars" pro Val Chmerkovskiy was suspended from this week's competition. It's the first suspension in the ABC show's 20-year history. The trouble started when judge Carrie-Ann Inaba criticized Chmerkovskiy's wife, who also danced on the show. Chmerkovskiy took to social media to defend his wife. Now, the dancer is apologizing.
title: Why Was Val Chmerkovskiy Suspended From 'Dancing With The Stars?'

author: Inside Edition
description: Playing the violin seems like a second language to Jayden King of Franklin Lakes, New Jersey. At just 11 years old, he has become very good at expressing himself with his instrument. Jayden's already won prestigious awards at the George Enescu Competition in Romania, taking the top prize in three categories. He tells WCBS his musical talent is very much part of his being. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 11-Year-Old New Jersey Violin Prodigy Wins Big At Competition In Romania

author: Inside Edition
description: A couple Sitting outside a Parisian café seemed unfazed by rioting protesters around them Saturday night. Video shows the couple calmly talking while smoking and drinking near the Arc de Triomphe. Flames from burning trash piles are seen in the background. Paris and cities across France were consumed by looting and violent protests over the weekend against rising prices and falling education standards. Demonstrations began a month ago by students protesting substandard school buildings and absent teachers.
title: Couple Carries On Drinking, Smoking As Paris Protests Erupt Around Them

author: Inside Edition
description: Sy Moran suffered several catastrophic injuries, including paralysis, after falling 40 feet from a ski lift.
title: Snowboarder Plummets 40 Feet Off Ski Lift #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: There was a desperate search for a husky poodle mix named Loulou. The 4-year-old dog was stranded for more than two days after an avalanche. Separated from her owner in the Alaskan wilderness, rescue pilots found the pooch thanks to an AirTag she was wearing. Following her rescuer's footsteps, the canine made her way to a chopper.
title: Dog Missing 2 Days After Avalanche Found By Rescuers
